business_profile.description: Roaring Fork is an American Western bistro offering bold flavors inspired by the rugged American West, featuring wood-fired cooking, rotisserie meats, and fresh fish in a vibrant lodge-style atmosphere.
business_profile.value_proposition: Exceptional American Western cuisine crafted with wood-fired cooking and rugged flavors in an upscale lodge setting.
business_profile.target_audience: Local diners, tourists, food enthusiasts, and guests seeking upscale casual dining with a distinct Western flair.

services_and_products.name: Dinner Menu
services_and_products.description: Selection of wood-fired steaks, chops, fresh fish, and signature American Western dishes.

services_and_products.name: Lunch & Happy Hour
services_and_products.description: Mid-day menu options and curated beverage selections with specialty appetizers.

brand_and_content.brand_positioning: Upscale American Western dining destination combining rugged culinary tradition with refined hospitality.
important_copy_snippets: Bold flavors from the American West.

design_and_ux.typography_assessment: Clean serif headers paired with readable sans-serif body text reflecting a rustic-modern dining brand.
design_and_ux.color_palette_assessment: Earthy tones featuring deep charcoals, warm ambers, and subtle wooden textures.
design_and_ux.layout_and_spacing: Standard single-column and multi-column grid structure highlighting high-photography imagery.
design_and_ux.ux_navigation_flow: Straightforward navigation prioritizing menu exploration and table reservations.
strengths: Clear call to action for reservations
weaknesses: Could benefit from more interactive menu features

technical_and_seo.seo_health: Adequate metadata structure, though localized keyword optimization could be expanded.
seo_weaknesses: Missing detailed schema markup for local restaurants
Limited descriptive alt attributes on visual assets
technical_and_seo.accessibility_observations: Color contrast appears generally sufficient, though interactive components need verified aria-labels.
technical_and_seo.performance_and_structure_notes: Optimized lightweight static assets recommended for fast mobile loading.

redesign_recommendations.overall_redesign_verdict: A modern refresh focused on immersive visual storytelling and seamless reservation integration will significantly boost conversion rates.
strategic_recommendations: Integrate direct OpenTable or Resy booking widgets into the primary navigation.
Highlight seasonal menu updates and chef specials right on the homepage.
ui_ux_improvements: Implement a warm editorial aesthetic with rich photography of signature wood-fired dishes.
Ensure sticky mobile reservation action bars for immediate user conversion.
rebuild_opportunities: Rebuild using Next.js and Tailwind CSS for superior performance and mobile responsiveness.
quick_wins: Add direct phone and address details clearly in the website footer.
Optimize meta descriptions for local search terms.

template_recommendation.reasoning: A warm editorial style with split hero sections and prominent reservation CTAs perfectly matches the upscale dining experience of an American Western bistro.
